Index: src/backend/api/quotes.py
===================================================================
--- src/backend/api/quotes.py	
+++ src/backend/api/quotes.py	
@@ -0,0 +1,276 @@
+import uuid
+from decimal import Decimal
+
+from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query, Response, status
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+
+from src.backend.core.deps import get_current_user, require_role
+from src.backend.core.roles import Role
+from src.backend.db.repositories.audit_repo import create_entry
+from src.backend.db.session import get_db
+from src.backend.models.user import User
+from src.backend.schemas.quote import (
+    QuoteApproveRequest,
+    QuoteCreate,
+    QuoteItemCreate,
+    QuoteListResponse,
+    QuoteRead,
+    QuoteRespondRequest,
+    QuoteSendRequest,
+    QuoteSubmitRequest,
+    QuoteUpdate,
+)
+from src.backend.services.quote_service import (
+    approve as approve_quote,
+    clone_to_draft,
+    generate_quote,
+    record_response,
+    send as send_quote,
+    submit_for_approval,
+    update_quote as update_quote_service,
+)
+from src.backend.services.pdf_service import generate_quote_pdf
+
+router = APIRouter(prefix="/api", tags=["quotes"])
+
+
+def _get_quote_with_relations(db: Session, quote_id: uuid.UUID) -> QuoteRead:
+    from src.backend.db.repositories.quote_repo import get_by_id
+    from src.backend.models.quote import Quote
+
+    quote = get_by_id(db, quote_id)
+    if not quote:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Quote not found")
+
+    result = QuoteRead.model_validate(quote)
+
+    if quote.project_id:
+        from src.backend.models.project import Project
+        project = db.query(Project).filter(Project.id == quote.project_id).first()
+        if project:
+            result.project_name = project.name
+
+    if quote.created_by:
+        from src.backend.models.user import User
+        creator = db.query(User).filter(User.id == quote.created_by).first()
+        if creator:
+            result.created_by_name = creator.name
+
+    if quote.approved_by:
+        from src.backend.models.user import User
+        approver = db.query(User).filter(User.id == quote.approved_by).first()
+        if approver:
+            result.approved_by_name = approver.name
+
+    return result
+
+
+@router.post("/projects/{project_id}/quotes", response_model=QuoteRead, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
+def create_quote(
+    project_id: uuid.UUID,
+    body: QuoteCreate,
+    current_user: User = Depends(require_role(Role.ADMIN, Role.PM)),
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+) -> QuoteRead:
+    try:
+        quote = generate_quote(
+            db,
+            project_id=project_id,
+            boq_id=body.boq_id,
+            markup_percent=body.markup_percent,
+            tax_percent=body.tax_percent,
+            terms=body.terms,
+            validity_days=body.validity_days,
+            created_by=current_user.id,
+        )
+        return _get_quote_with_relations(db, quote.id)
+    except ValueError as e:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(e)) from e
+
+
+@router.get("/projects/{project_id}/quotes", response_model=QuoteListResponse)
+def list_quotes(
+    project_id: uuid.UUID,
+    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+    page: int = Query(default=1, ge=1),
+    page_size: int = Query(default=20, ge=1, le=100),
+) -> QuoteListResponse:
+    from src.backend.db.repositories.quote_repo import list_by_project
+
+    items, total, page, page_size = list_by_project(db, project_id, page=page, page_size=page_size)
+
+    quotes = []
+    for quote in items:
+        q = QuoteRead.model_validate(quote)
+        if quote.project_id:
+            from src.backend.models.project import Project
+            project = db.query(Project).filter(Project.id == quote.project_id).first()
+            if project:
+                q.project_name = project.name
+        quotes.append(q)
+
+    return QuoteListResponse(items=quotes, total=total, page=page, page_size=page_size)
+
+
+@router.get("/quotes/{quote_id}", response_model=QuoteRead)
+def get_quote(
+    quote_id: uuid.UUID,
+    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+) -> QuoteRead:
+    return _get_quote_with_relations(db, quote_id)
+
+
+@router.patch("/quotes/{quote_id}", response_model=QuoteRead)
+def update_quote(
+    quote_id: uuid.UUID,
+    body: QuoteUpdate,
+    current_user: User = Depends(require_role(Role.ADMIN, Role.PM)),
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+) -> QuoteRead:
+    from src.backend.db.repositories.quote_repo import get_by_id
+
+    quote = get_by_id(db, quote_id)
+    if not quote:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Quote not found")
+
+    if quote.status not in ("draft",):
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Can only update draft quotes")
+
+    update_data = body.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
+    if "items" in update_data:
+        del update_data["items"]
+
+    updated = update_quote_service(db, quote_id, update_data)
+    if not updated:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Failed to update quote")
+
+    create_entry(
+        db,
+        action="quote.update",
+        entity_type="quote",
+        entity_id=quote_id,
+        user_id=current_user.id,
+        before_json={"status": quote.status},
+        after_json={"status": updated.status},
+    )
+
+    return _get_quote_with_relations(db, quote_id)
+
+
+@router.delete("/quotes/{quote_id}", status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)
+def delete_quote(
+    quote_id: uuid.UUID,
+    current_user: User = Depends(require_role(Role.ADMIN, Role.PM)),
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+) -> None:
+    from src.backend.db.repositories.quote_repo import get_by_id, soft_delete
+
+    quote = get_by_id(db, quote_id)
+    if not quote:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Quote not found")
+
+    if quote.status not in ("draft",):
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Can only delete draft quotes")
+
+    success = soft_delete(db, quote_id)
+    if not success:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Failed to delete quote")
+
+    create_entry(
+        db,
+        action="quote.delete",
+        entity_type="quote",
+        entity_id=quote_id,
+        user_id=current_user.id,
+        before_json={"status": quote.status},
+        after_json={"status": "deleted"},
+    )
+
+
+@router.post("/quotes/{quote_id}/submit", response_model=QuoteRead)
+def submit_quote(
+    quote_id: uuid.UUID,
+    body: QuoteSubmitRequest,
+    current_user: User = Depends(require_role(Role.ADMIN, Role.PM)),
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+) -> QuoteRead:
+    try:
+        updated = submit_for_approval(db, quote_id, current_user.id)
+        return _get_quote_with_relations(db, updated.id)
+    except ValueError as e:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(e)) from e
+
+
+@router.post("/quotes/{quote_id}/approve", response_model=QuoteRead)
+def approve_quote(
+    quote_id: uuid.UUID,
+    body: QuoteApproveRequest,
+    current_user: User = Depends(require_role(Role.ADMIN)),
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+) -> QuoteRead:
+    try:
+        updated = approve_quote(db, quote_id, current_user.id)
+        return _get_quote_with_relations(db, updated.id)
+    except ValueError as e:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(e)) from e
+
+
+@router.post("/quotes/{quote_id}/send", response_model=QuoteRead)
+def send_quote(
+    quote_id: uuid.UUID,
+    body: QuoteSendRequest,
+    current_user: User = Depends(require_role(Role.ADMIN, Role.PM)),
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+) -> QuoteRead:
+    try:
+        updated = send_quote(db, quote_id, current_user.id)
+        return _get_quote_with_relations(db, updated.id)
+    except ValueError as e:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(e)) from e
+
+
+@router.post("/quotes/{quote_id}/respond", response_model=QuoteRead)
+def respond_quote(
+    quote_id: uuid.UUID,
+    body: QuoteRespondRequest,
+    current_user: User = Depends(require_role(Role.ADMIN, Role.PM)),
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+) -> QuoteRead:
+    try:
+        updated = record_response(db, quote_id, body.response, body.notes, current_user.id)
+        return _get_quote_with_relations(db, updated.id)
+    except ValueError as e:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(e)) from e
+
+
+@router.post("/quotes/{quote_id}/clone", response_model=QuoteRead, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
+def clone_quote(
+    quote_id: uuid.UUID,
+    current_user: User = Depends(require_role(Role.ADMIN, Role.PM)),
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+) -> QuoteRead:
+    try:
+        new_quote = clone_to_draft(db, quote_id, current_user.id)
+        return _get_quote_with_relations(db, new_quote.id)
+    except ValueError as e:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(e)) from e
+
+
+@router.get("/quotes/{quote_id}/pdf")
+def download_quote_pdf(
+    quote_id: uuid.UUID,
+    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+) -> Response:
+    quote = _get_quote_with_relations(db, quote_id)
+    pdf_bytes = generate_quote_pdf(quote)
+
+    return Response(
+        content=pdf_bytes,
+        media_type="application/pdf",
+        headers={
+            "Content-Disposition": f'attachment; filename="quote-{quote_id}.pdf"',
+        },
+    )
